motionAllow.name: ds-shell-sidebar
motionAllow.reason: The design-system app shell animates its sidebar column when it collapses (css/layout.css .ds-shell). The shell owns it. Ford allowed it for knowledge-system, and this config reuses that allowance for the same shell.

pages.note: The game on load: the start card (title, sound settings, controls) over the 3D course. The app has one theme: index.html fixes data-theme="dark", and the HUD floats over a 3D scene. Serve a build on the base URL (in game/: vite build --outDir <tmp>, then vite preview --outDir <tmp> --port 47740): the dev server is too slow. Every page draws a live WebGL canvas, and design:score launches Chromium with --disable-gpu, so a busy machine can push the game pages past the 15 s waitFor.
Playing: the overlay is hidden, so only the timer, checkpoint and speed HUD show over the canvas.
Paused with Esc: the card with Restart, sound settings and controls.
The clip viewer: a panel over the 3D clip preview.
